Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Wallpaper samples too small, did not include the pattern only the background](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a1313d03506a364760670ad)
I appreciated the free service of the wallpaper and the service went well, the wallpaper sample was so small it didn’t include the pattern of the wallpaper so it was pointless. For 500 dollars a roll, L&G can provide a large enough sample for the full pattern to be seen. The shipping process was long enough I’m just going to move on to find different wallpaper since I can’t evaluate it without waiting weeks, so I can’t imagine the savings on tiny samples is worth the loss of a sale.

May 11, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 26, 2026

Hi Caroline,

Thank you so much for reaching out and sharing your feedback. I completely understand how frustrating it must be to receive wallpaper samples that aren't helpful in making an informed decision. We have shared your concerns with our team and are actively working on providing better samples in the future. We sincerely appreciate your patience and are truly Sorry for any inconvenience this has caused.

Lulu and Georgia
